gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-geist: Cosmic and loose-limbed, Galaxy draws every letter in one unbroken line width, with a dense, tall lowercase band. Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, and that restraint is the pair's quiet strength.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-georama: Galaxy draws every letter in a single uninterrupted line width, with loose spacing and a dense, tall lowercase. And Georama, with a c like a bracelet pulled apart, can take a generous size, since its capitals barely rise.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-gidole: Galaxy holds one unbroken line width through every letter, with a dense, tall lowercase band, loose spacing for presence. Gidole, with its open terminals and neon-tube consistency, does the quieter work of staying out of the way.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-golos-text: Galaxy sets a dense, tall lowercase in one uninterrupted line width, spaced loosely, with a cosmic, commanding presence. Golos Text reads smoothly, its large x-height filling each line.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Marker-traced cosmic swagger: Galaxy commands with a dense, tall lowercase band and loose spacing. Hedvig Letters Sans does the friendlier job, its small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, with a clear gap in the c.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-heebo: Commanding from the first letter, Galaxy keeps a single-width stroke in every glyph, with a dense, tall lowercase band and loose spacing. And Heebo keeps paragraphs moving, its tall central band and curves that stop short of closing.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hind-guntur: Cosmic through and through, Galaxy draws a single line width on every letter, with loose spacing and a dense, tall lowercase band. And Hind Guntur, with wide gaps at its curve ends, carries paragraphs along without a snag.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hind-madurai: Loud and loose: Galaxy draws every letter at a single line width, with a dense, tall lowercase band. But Hind Madurai matches that presence with lowercase that fills the line like capitals.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase tops close to the ascender height. Beside Galaxy's loose, cosmic spacing and unbroken line width, that compact, calligraphy-free text gives the heading room to command.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along at a constant line weight, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle. And paragraphs glide along with a gentle bump up to capitals, leaving Galaxy to do the shouting.
